notes.title: Mac with HTC Vive
notes.notes:
Mac users may now experience the VR world with the HTC Vive headset.

This requires the SteamVR app beta. In Library > Tools, right-click (or control-click) on SteamVR and go to Properties; select the "Betas" tab and choose SteamVR Beta from the dropdown. Then launch the SteamVR app to configure your HTC Vive.

notes.title: Loading screen
notes.notes: The loading screen provides some context about the SuperKEKB particle accelerator and Belle II detector while the app initializes.

notes.title: Now with sound
notes.notes:
As the particles traverse the Belle II detector, a sound accompanies each hit in the sensitive ("information-recording") elements. There is a different sound for each detector type (PXD, SVD, CDC, iTOP, ARICH, ECL, BKLM, EKLM).

Use the in-game main menu to control the sound master volume.

If you use an Xbox controller, you may now rotate your orientation in 3D using the right joystick while pressing either bumper. (As before, you may rotate in the horizontal plane with or without the bumper press.)
